text: When a reviewer reports a file missing from a PR, check git and disk first; it may never have been saved, so re-implement it from the PR description plus the existing CSS and HTML.
In this environment, run git as `git -C <dir>`; `cd <dir> && git ...` triggers an approval prompt and fails in unattended runs.
child-page: the .n-lines SVG uses preserveAspectRatio=none; with vector-effect non-scaling-stroke removed, stroke widths and dasharrays in css/style.css are in viewBox (0-100) units, not pixels.

child-page: activity elements that must be keyboard-accessible need tabindex=0 plus a keydown handler for Enter/Space alongside pointerdown, and a :focus-visible outline in css/style.css; position dynamic nodes in percent so they survive orientation changes.
child-page: for keyboard activation of pointerdown-wired buttons, add a click listener guarded by e.detail === 0 (Enter/Space) and remove both listeners in the mount cleanup.

Reworker: the revisions-required label may show as 'revisions-required:wip' claim label; `gh pr edit --remove-label revisions-required` still works. child-page has no test suite, so verify JS with `node --check`.

child-page: don't rely on SVG pathLength with stroke-dasharray for line-draw effects (unreliable across browsers); set the real length via a --len CSS variable computed in JS and use it for dasharray/dashoffset.

Reworker: `git merge` fails in this env without an identity; export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL (and GIT_AUTHOR_*) before merging main into a PR branch, then finish with `gh-as-agent commit` and `gh-as-agent push --repo <clone>` run from inside the clone dir.

child-page: activities mount inside .stage, and the global `.stage svg {width:120px;height:120px}` rule (specificity 0,1,1) overrides single-class SVG sizing like .n-lines; scope activity SVG overlay selectors as `.stage .<class>` or they shrink to 120px and misalign with percent-positioned elements.

Reworker: an add/add conflict on a stacked PR's file means main already holds an older copy; keep the PR's newer version with `git checkout --ours <file>` during `git merge origin/main`, then re-check `gh pr view --json mergeable` after a few seconds because GitHub's status lags.

child-page: for SVG parts that must scale around a fixed point (e.g. butterfly wings folding to the body axis), set the SVG transform attribute (scale about user-space origin) from JS; CSS transform-box: view-box with transform-origin percentages ignores an offset viewBox (e.g. -50 -40 100 80) and folds toward the wrong side.

child-page playtime.js: when a localStorage write fails, keep an in-memory copy of state and have load() use it (storageOk flag) so refresh-from-storage doesn't discard used time; guard once-only expiry rendering with a per-start flag in app.js.

child-page: Playtime.start() calls stop() which cancels fades, so in app.js render() call Playtime.start(cb) before Playtime.renderLater(stage); set the shownLater flag before start() since the expiry callback only fires on a later tick.

Reworker: labels like `<outcome>:wip` and `<outcome>:completed` (e.g. ready-for-review:completed, revisions-required:completed) are platform claim/tracking labels set on flow transitions; agents don't manage them, and a human may remove leftovers manually.

child-page playtime.js: paint() must not set stage opacity to 1 at progress >= 1, because the expiry tick calls paint() before onExpire/renderLater reads the current opacity; setting 1 there makes the moon fade jump to full brightness first.

child-page: tap targets for small floating elements (e.g. the day/night bird) need both width and min-height >= 48px; make the button display:flex; align-items:center so the SVG stays centred without changing its drawn size.

child-page Day/Night (js/dzien-i-noc.js): the cloud/bird/night-flyer logic all runs from one rAF loop (cloudTick); night flyers (satellite, blinking airplane) are .dn-fly divs inside .dn-stars, spawned only when progress>=0.95 and target===1, so they fade with the sky and work under prefers-reduced-motion.

Reworker: 'Night Sky' in human feedback can mean either Nocne Niebo (js/niebo.js, star-connecting game) or Day/Night (js/dzien-i-noc.js, whose Big Dipper was the only constellation); when ambiguous, post a blocking PR comment + human-decision-required and aee-ask before editing.

child-page Day/Night: stars added over time are JS-grown (starTick in the shared rAF loop, 1px -> target via smoothstep, transform translate(-50%,-50%) so they grow around their centre) instead of CSS animation, so they survive prefers-reduced-motion; total star count is capped (STAR_CAP).

Reworker: a human PR comment like 'Implement optional suggestions' makes the reviewer's optional suggestions mandatory; the local clone may sit on another branch, so fetch and `git checkout -b
origin/
`, and `git add` before `gh-as-agent commit` (it doesn't stage).

Reworker: a stacked PR's base branch is another feature branch (check `gh pr view --json baseRefName`); resolve 'merge conflicts' by merging origin/<base> into the PR branch (with GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER env set, `git -C <dir>` form only; chained `&&` with checkout/merge triggers an approval prompt), keeping the PR's own side for the contested hunk.
child-page deszczyk.js: rainTotal (time toward the next rainbow) only accumulates while bowState === 0 and is reset when a rainbow starts, so rain during a rainbow doesn't chain a second one.

child-page pociag.js station-stop: cap Hermite duration T at 2.85*D/v (monotone while v*T<=3D) and add a lap only if T would be <2.5s; layout() re-plans an active stop via goStation() so resize doesn't snap.

child-page: sibling activity PRs stacked on feature/menu-scroll-28 all append to the same spots (js/activities.js list end, script tags before app.js, end of css/style.css), so merge conflicts between them are additive: keep both sides, then re-add the trailing comma on the former last activities.js entry and run node --check on every js file.

Reworker: when a human says 'implement the optional suggestions' and one is manual device testing, fix the code ones, post a blocking comment and apply human-decision-required rather than ready-for-review.

Reworker: for 'implement optional suggestions' on activity PRs, the 'confirm on a device' item is manual; do the code ones, post a blocking comment and apply human-decision-required (not ready-for-review).

Reworker: the hand-off gate holds ready-for-review back when a PR conflicts with its base ('Hand-off held back: merge conflict'), re-setting revisions-required; fix by merging origin/<base>, then re-add ready-for-review and remove stale revisions-required:completed.

child-page banki.js: Back-button/hourglass keep-out is measured each frame from document.querySelector('.back'/'.hourglass') rects (+12px pad) instead of a fixed pixel corner, so safe-area insets and the optional hourglass are handled; tiny bubbles (r <= MIN_R*1.2) fade on touch rather than ignore it.

Reworker: before `git merge` check the current branch with `git branch --show-current`; a failed `checkout -b` (branch already exists) leaves you on the previous branch, and the merge then fast-forwards the wrong one. Use `checkout
` + `reset --hard origin/
` for a stale local branch, and re-fetch the base right before pushing because sibling activity PRs keep landing on it.

Reworker: in this sandbox `cd <repo> && git ...` triggers an approval prompt; use `git -C <dir>` and run python/grep from another cwd. A regex over conflict markers (keep both sides, append our entry last with comma fix) resolves additive activity-PR conflicts quickly.
child-page: CSS class prefixes are shared globally; Policz Razem owns .pr/.pr-board/.pr-btn/.pr-glow, so new activities need a distinct prefix (Przeciwieństwa uses pw-).

Reworker: child-page SVG activities that render two copies of the same SVG (e.g. reduced-motion cross-fade) must give clipPath/gradient ids a per-copy suffix, since duplicate ids in one document are invalid.

Reworker: in this sandbox `git merge` needs an identity; use `git -C <dir> -c user.name=<agent> -c user.email=<agent>@agents.local merge --no-commit origin/main`, resolve, then commit with the same -c flags.

Reworker: child-page activity PRs targeting main keep conflicting as siblings merge (each appends to the same README/CSS/index.html/activities.js spots); after resolving, renumber the README item and the intro count word to match the merged base before pushing.

Reworker: when resolving activity-PR conflicts with a regex keep-both script, check for a missing comma after the previous last entry in js/activities.js (node --check catches it) and bump the README intro count word (e.g. sixteen -> seventeen) and item number.

Reworker: a revisions-required wake caused only by the hand-off gate's 'merge conflict with main' comment has no review feedback; just merge origin/main, keep both sides, put the new activity last (comma fix), and bump the README count word and item number.

Reworker: the hand-off gate's 'merge conflict with main' revisions-required wakes on child-page activity PRs recur as siblings merge; each is resolved by merging origin/main, keeping both sides with our entry last and bumping the README count word and item number.

Reworker: an 'Implement optional suggestions' comment on a child-page activity PR whose only optional ask is manual device testing means: resolve any merge conflict, then apply human-decision-required (not ready-for-review) and ask a human to record device results.

Reworker: for activity-PR merge conflicts a python re.sub keep-both resolver works (CSS/index.html: main's side first, ours last; activities.js: add a comma after main's last entry); then bump the README intro count word and item number.

Reworker: after a regex keep-both conflict resolve on a child-page activity PR, the new entry can land mid-list in js/activities.js and index.html (our side sits before sibling entries); move it to the very end and fix the comma before pushing.

Reworker: when 'Implement optional suggestions' also mentions a stale PR body count (e.g. 'entry 15/fifteen'), fix it with gh pr edit --body-file after the conflict merge so it matches the final README item number and count word.

Reworker: a keep-both conflict resolve on child-page's README can leave two intro lines (HEAD and main versions both survive when the conflict isn't marked); after merging, check the first lines of README.md for a duplicate intro and the highest item number on main before numbering your own.

Reworker: right after a cleanup sweep that removes ':completed'/':wip' tracking labels, a freshly added human-decision-required label can disappear; always re-check `gh pr view --json labels` after a few seconds and re-add it if missing.

Reworker: to keep human-decision-required from being dropped, strip the ':completed'/':wip' tracking labels first, wait a few seconds, then add human-decision-required and verify with gh pr view --json labels.

Reworker: child-page activity-PR conflict wakes keep recurring; the python re.sub keep-both resolver (theirs first, ours last, comma fix in activities.js, README intro line taken from main) works in one pass, then set README count word and item number to main's highest + 1.

Reworker: when the Code Reviewer hands a child-page PR back unreviewed only for a merge conflict, the right outcome after resolving it is ready-for-review (a full review has not happened yet), unlike the 'Implement optional suggestions' device-test case which uses human-decision-required.

Reworker: parallel child-page activity PRs all claim the same next README item number/count word against current main, so after one merges the rest re-conflict; expect repeat conflict wakes and renumber each time (highest item on main + 1).

Reworker: to fix a CSS prefix collision on a child-page activity, sed-rename only the activity's own CSS line range in css/style.css plus its js file, then grep for the new prefix across css and js to confirm it is unused.

Reworker: child-page block/drag activities that size pieces as fractions of a base unit U must floor U so the smallest piece (e.g. 0.8*U) is still >=56px; for wieza.js the floor is 70, and the tower unit Ut is separate so placed blocks may shrink to ~48px on short screens.

Reworker: before `gh-as-agent push --branch X`, the local branch must be named exactly like the remote PR branch (use `git checkout -b <pr-branch> origin/<pr-branch>`); a differently named local branch gets pushed as a stray new remote branch that must be deleted.

Reworker: on a child-page 'Implement optional suggestions' wake, when the reviewer's only optional item matches the issue wording and the rest is manual device testing, make no code change beyond the conflict merge and pause with human-decision-required.

Reworker: a revisions-required wake after the Code Reviewer already accepted a PR (only a manual device check left) needs no code change: strip revisions-required and ':wip' labels, confirm with git merge-tree that main still merges cleanly, and make sure human-decision-required is present.

Reworker: an 'Implement optional suggestions' wake after the Code Reviewer's re-review accepted a child-page PR needs no code change when the only optional item is a visual note for manual testing; verify main still merges cleanly (git merge-tree --write-tree), strip stale tracking labels, then pause with human-decision-required.

Reworker: to stop a child-page rAF loop when idle (e.g. buzki.js idle blink), end frame() without re-requesting rAF when nothing is animating and arm a setTimeout that re-enters start(); clear the timer in start(), on visibility hidden and in cleanup.

Reworker: PR bodies for child-page activities sometimes carry no item number/count text at all; grep the body for the count word and item number before editing it, and skip gh pr edit --body-file when nothing matches.

Reworker: a PR paused with human-decision-required still re-conflicts as siblings merge, and the paused state hides it; on any wake, check `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/<pr-branch> origin/main` and re-merge main (renumber README) even when no review feedback is pending.

Reworker: while many child-page activity PRs are parked on human-decision-required, each merge of a sibling to main re-conflicts the others; on every wake re-merge origin/main (renumber README to main's highest + 1) and post a short comment, keeping human-decision-required on until a human records device results.

Reworker: child-page PR descriptions often hard-code the README entry number and count word in two places (the 'README entry N and the count updated to X' line and a merge-conflicts note); sed both when renumbering after a merge so the body doesn't go stale.

Reworker: removing ':completed'/':wip' tracking labels can also drop an already-present human-decision-required label on a parked PR; after the sweep, wait ~8 s, check `gh pr view --json labels` and re-add human-decision-required if the list is empty.

Reworker: child-page nested-interactive fix pattern — make the moving wrapper a plain div holding a real <button> overlay for the main action plus sibling buttons, bind it with bindTap, and drop role=button/tabindex and the custom keydown handler (native button handles Enter/Space via click detail 0).

Reworker: in the child-page clone `git merge` fails with 'unable to auto-detect email' (git identity unset); export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL and GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL for the merge, then finish with `gh-as-agent commit`.

Reworker: child-page Farma (js/farma.js) pool is HAND (4 hand-drawn) + SHARED id list; adding an animal to SHARED is enough, since figures are drawn generically via Animals.head and labelled from Animals.byId(n).name.

Reworker: a repeat revisions-required wake on a PR already reworked and parked with human-decision-required needs no code change; remove revisions-required and :wip, and re-apply human-decision-required if the tracking-label sweep dropped it.

Reworker: when stripping tracking labels on a PR parked with human-decision-required, don't pass it to --remove-label; run `gh-as-agent commit` from inside the clone (or via git -C) because from the workspace root it fails with 'not a git repository' while the push still succeeds with nothing new.

Reworker: in the child-page clone, compound shell commands (`export …; git merge`, `a && b`) trigger approval prompts; run `git -c user.name=x -c user.email=y@z merge origin/main` as a single command instead.

Reworker: to validate child-page star/planet layout fixes, eval the LAYOUTS literal from the JS file in node and check pairwise centre distances (>=56px hit boxes) over viewports 320x568..1920x1080; moving the cluster's other star may avoid new planet clashes.

Reworker: a human comment like 'Implement optional changes' on a child-page PR means the reviewer's optional suggestions are now mandatory; do the code ones, and park the manual device/browser checks with human-decision-required.
child-page Łódź Podwodna (js/podwodna.js): sand glide is forward-only — a target behind the sub uses f1+1 (glide.fwd), with f wrapped each frame via an unwrapped glide.cur for velocity.

Reworker: a revisions-required wake whose only feedback is optional manual checks can still hide a main merge conflict on child-page; check `gh pr view --json mergeable` first and merge origin/main (README Activities list: keep both sides' entries) before parking with human-decision-required.

Reworker: in the child-page clone, `git checkout <branch>` fails if the branch isn't local; run `git fetch origin <branch>` then `git checkout -B <branch> origin/<branch>` as separate single commands (compound commands trigger approval prompts).

Reworker: in child-page frame()-style rAF loops, `raf` is zeroed at frame start, so guarding the trailing request with `if (busy && !raf)` is enough to keep a single loop when a sync callback restarts it.

Reworker: when merging main into a child-page branch that added Analytics.levelStart/levelComplete calls, a conflict in an activity file (e.g. puzzle.js build()) is resolved by taking main's logic and re-adding the Analytics call after the state it reports (N), then node --check and confirm the call count with grep.

child-page analytics on main: js/app.js reports activity start/end for ALL activities and analytics.js counts stage touches; only puzzle, pamiec, ksztalty, policz-razem call levelStart/levelComplete/complete and literki calls levelStart/track('interaction') itself; docs/activities section 13 should reflect this.

Reworker: in the child-page clone `git merge` is blocked by approval prompts; for docs-only rework read main's state with `git show origin/main:<path>` and bulk-edit docs with a python3 -I script instead.

Reworker: in the child-page clone a plain `git merge` prompts for approval and fails on missing committer identity; `git -C <clone> -c user.name=... -c user.email=... merge origin/main --no-commit --no-ff` works, then resolve and commit with gh-as-agent commit.

Reworker: for a docs PR the reviewer says is stale after a sibling merged, merge main first, then split the per-activity docs among helper agents with disjoint file lists (they can fail on API errors midway, so re-check git status and relaunch the unfinished files), and finish with a script check of 21 sections per file, relative links, and a grep for '#<issue>', 'not on `main`' and '(open)'.

Reworker: for a child-page 'Implement optional suggestions' wake, do the code-only suggestions, note a docs/activities page as a follow-up if docs/ is not on main yet, and park visual/device checks with human-decision-required.

Reworker: a repeat wake on a child-page PR already parked with human-decision-required needs no change when git merge-tree --write-tree origin/<branch> origin/main is clean, the label is present and docs/ is still absent on main; just report and leave labels alone.

child-page docs: activity doc filenames drop Polish diacritics entirely (ó->o, ł->l), e.g. Rasy Piesków -> rasy-pieskow.md; a new activity also needs a row in docs/activities/README.md and the 'all N activities' count there bumped.

Reworker: to fix a child-page dog-race button narrower than 56px, keep the art at its sprite width (dh*6/5) and set the button width to max(56, dw), centring the art in the button; the position maths (pw) must use the button width.
Reworker: when a reviewer reports a child-page activity that renders nothing, check that mount() calls container.appendChild(root) before layout(); cleanup already removes root.
Reworker: child-page activity SVGs inside #stage are shrunk to 120px by the global '.stage svg' rule, so activity SVG CSS must use '.stage .xx-svg, .xx-svg' (specificity 0,2,0) for width/height 100%.

Reworker: in child-page plac.js a fade-on-reset needs no new code, just stop zeroing the shown[] stage array and let the existing approach loop fade it; defer the house recolour until all stages reach 0 (flag + busy() true meanwhile).

Reworker: in child-page, a top bar or list at top-left needs padding-left calc(var(--safe-l) + 72px) to clear the fixed 56px .back button; size list items from the container width (e.g. floor((W-168)/5)) so 5 items plus a counter still fit at 320px.

Reworker: child-page looping canvas decoration layers (e.g. sea waves) must have pattern period dividing the loop; when item count N does not divide the cycle (7 vs wv%3, or a lam*7/6 period), switch to N items over period lam with N divisible by the height cycle, keeping spacing identical.

Reworker: shell commands that start with `cd <repo> && git ...` or contain `{ ... }` with quotes in inline python are blocked by the harness; use `git -C <repo>`, run a script file with `python3 -I`, or `gh --repo` instead.

Reworker: `gh-as-agent commit` must run from inside the clone (`cd <repo> && gh-as-agent commit -m ...`); a `-C <dir>` argument is passed to `git commit` itself, where it means reuse-message, not change directory.

Reworker: in child-page analytics docs, state the number of self-reporting activities only via the table rows (intro says 'The following activities…'), since a hard-coded count in the README intro goes stale each time a new activity starts calling Analytics; a sed bump on one README can miss the same phrase in docs/activities/README.md, so grep both.

Reworker: a child-page 'Implement optional suggestions' wake where the reviewer's only open item is a device visual check needs no code change: post a PR comment, apply human-decision-required, strip revisions-required and :wip labels.

child-page Nakarm Pieska (js/nakarm.js): the dog's size-change complaint came from render() applying scaleY(0.8)+translateY in lie/yawn/out phases; the yawn is a head tilt only, so no body squash belongs there.

Reworker: 'Implement optional changes' wake on child-page Zakupy with a one-line code fix plus a manual device check: apply the code fix, post a PR comment, set human-decision-required instead of ready-for-review.

child-page Zbuduj Rakiete (js/zbuduj.js): tray is 12 buttons grouped by kind in TRAY_KINDS order (nose, body, fins, engine); each item carries g (group) and v (position in group); layout() maps g/v to column/row in portrait and row/column in landscape, variants shuffled within each group.

child-page Zbuduj Rakietę (js/zbuduj.js): flight scenery is driven by progress p in render(): night overlay and stars fade in over p 0.2-0.65 and the Moon layer (height 1.3H) must start fully above the screen (-1.35H) and slide in only after p 0.7, otherwise it covers the sky from take-off.
